title: IssuesPayload
description: Workflow payload: source corpus locations, curated Markdown path, and issues list as peer fields (for flow.payload when merged into the flow envelope).

sources.description: Corpus locations from the job when valid; JSON null if Intake found no valid sources (orchestrator may apply a demo default).

type.description: Kind of location the source string refers to.

source.description: Location string matching type: directory path, file path, or URL.

curated.description: Path or filename of the Markdown file that holds reduced text for every verified source. Null until Intake finishes curation (or when no sources verified).

oneOf.description: Path to the curated .md file (usually under out_dir).

items.description: List of issues surfaced during analysis of communications between numerous parties. Order may match each item's id when ids are assigned as placement order, but ids are only a shorthand reference during processing and need only be unique within this list.

id.description: Unique shorthand identifier for this issue within the list (handy for cross-references during processing; not a permanent external key).

name.description: Brief summary name for the issue.

reasons.description: One or more rationales supporting inclusion.

source.description: Where in the source material this justification was found (file and entity/identity).

quote.description: Quotation from the source material supporting inclusion.

confirmed.description: Whether source and quote have been independently confirmed as true and accurate.

validated.description: Whether this issue has been designated valid.

quality.description: Whether this issue has been approved by quality assurance.

discrepancies.description: Problems raised against this item, with remediation status.

id.description: Unique shorthand identifier for this discrepancy within this issue's discrepancies array (for processing references only).

station.description: Workflow station that applied this discrepancy.

agent.description: Agent or job identity that applied this discrepancy.

resolution.description: open = unresolved; pending = remedy applied; closed = adequately remediated.
